profile.name: Tarry Singh
profile.positioning: CEO and AI transformation leader for CEO and Chief AI Officer / CTO mandates: 30 years leading data, digital and AI change for energy, telecoms, financial-services and public-sector organisations across Europe, the Gulf and the United States. Founder-CEO of an AI group since 2017, taking AI from board-level strategy to production, with the operating model, workforce reskilling and governance to make it stick.

referencesPolicy.text: References from clients, partners and colleagues are available at the appropriate stage, each with the referee's consent.

closingLine.text: Data first, models second, and the client keeps the keys.
